variant.briefing:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [Location]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TargetName] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TargetName] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TargetName] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows
